notes.title: V0.60.007.02 update notes!
notes.notes:
A new week is here, and so are the new updates and fixes! There are no cracks in the law in my heaven and earth in the beginning! The "Return of the Magical Treasures of Heaven and Earth" prepared by our publisher IndieArk; Independent Ark is in full swing. Daoists who want to participate can go to the previous event announcements, or check our Weibo and Bilibili social media account~

1. Fix the exploration points related to the plot, clearing the level before accepting the mission may cause the plot to not trigger properly
2. Fixed the issue that you can pass the round by pressing the shortcut key when trading
3. Fix the problem that Taoist temples and temples display the last user's vertical painting
4. Fixed the problem that when a character performs multiple assignments at the same time, if one assignment ends first, the character status will become idle
5. Fixed the problem that the character position would be dislocated when clicking on the teleport while clicking on the node
6. Optimize the system bonus calculation, now the main system such as body refining and Taoism can use the bonus coefficient of the sub-system
7. Optimize the distribution of initial monster spirit roots to solve the problem that wood essence is difficult to obtain

There are quite a lot of Taoist friends who have reported that they can't find the pill recipe. You can enter IndieArk Discord channel and look at the online documentation! The way to get the main materials, the recipes, the entries~ everything!

Shout out to the amazing mod community helping translate the game to English, this announcement is translated by Okairo, The Ancient from AMA mod channel!
